Ra Random Bonus.text1: One of 6 bonuses is randomly selected and applied:
Ra Random Bonus.text2: From {{value1}} to {{value2}} multipliers appear in random spots on the reels. If the spots with multipliers become winning, these multipliers are summed and applied to the win.
Ra Random Bonus.text5: Random symbols transform into Empty Wilds.
Ra Random Bonus.text6: Level 1 - {{value1}} or {{value2}} symbols transform into Empty Wilds.
Ra Random Bonus.text7: Level 2 - {{value1}} or {{value2}} symbols transform into Empty Wilds.
Ra Random Bonus.text8: All landed Low symbols are replaced with High symbols.
Ra Random Bonus.text9: Level 1 - all Low symbols are replaced with their matching royal symbols: green to Yohannes IV, blue to Tewodros II, purple to Haile Selassie, and red to Menelik II.
Ra Random Bonus.text10: Level 2 - the two most valuable Low symbols are replaced with the Menelik II symbol, other two Low symbols are replaced with the Haile Selassie symbol.
Ra Random Bonus.text11: A symbol is randomly selected, and all instances of that symbol that land are replaced with Empty Wilds.
Ra Random Bonus.text14: A spot on the reels is randomly selected. The symbol that lands in this spot, along with all other instances of that symbol, are replaced with Empty Wilds.
Ra Random Bonus.text15: Level 1 - 1 spot on the reels is chosen.
Ra Random Bonus.text16: Level 2 - 2 spots on the reels are chosen.
Ra Random Bonus.text17: A reel is randomly selected, and all 3 of its symbols are replaced with Empty Wilds.

rules.text1: Gates of Abyssinia is a 3x5 reel, 10 bet line video slot. The game features Royal Re-spins, Ra Random Bonus (consists of 6 randomly selected bonuses), and Choose a King feature with two types of Free Spins to choose from (Ra Free Spins and Nephthys Free Spins) and with Bless Multipliers and Treasury Bonus each.
rules.text2: The game is played with 10 bet lines and different bet values.
rules.text3: Symbols pay from left to right on adjacent reels starting from the leftmost reel.
rules.text4: Winning symbol payouts are made according to the paytable.
rules.text5: Only the highest winning combination is paid per line.
rules.text6: The payout values displayed in the Paytable adjust dynamically based on the chosen bet amount.
rules.text7: Wild symbols (Empty Wild, Ra Wild, Nephthys Wild or Bless Wild) act as substitutes for any paying symbols on this line and count as the symbol which creates the highest winning combination on a single payline.
rules.text9: Royal Re-spins. The round continues with re-spins until Ra Wild or Nephthys Wild (wilds charged with bonus energy) appear in winning combinations.
rules.text10: The Royal Re-spin feature increases the chances of Ra Wild and Nephthys Wild appearing.
rules.text11: An Empty Wild is a regular Wild without Ra or Nephthys bonus energy.
rules.text12: If Ra Wild is a winning symbol, it triggers Royal Re-spin with application of the Ra Random Bonus.
rules.text13: If there are {{value}} or more winning Ra Wilds, the Ra Random Bonus of level 2 is triggered.
rules.text14: If Nephthys Wild is a winning symbol, it fills one cell of the Free Spins Bar and triggers the Royal Re-spin.
rules.text15: If a player fills all 3 cells of the Free Spins Bar within a single round (including Royal Re-spins), he receives Free Spins.
rules.text16: Choose a King. When awarded Free Spins, the player can choose one of two modes:
rules.text17: {{value}} Ra Free Spins with Ra Random Bonus (higher volatility)
rules.text18: {{value}} Nephthys Free Spins without Ra Random Bonus (lower volatility)
rules.Bless Wild & Bless Bar & Bless Multiplie: Bless Wild & Bless Bar & Bless Multipliers
rules.text19: Bless Wild can appear anywhere on the reels in Free Spins mode.
rules.text21: If Bless Wild is a winning symbol, it activates and opens. Either red Ra Bless Energy or violet Nephthys Bless Energy randomly appears from Bless Wild and fills one cell of the Bless Bar. Triggers Re-spin.
rules.text22: Bless Bar is a progress bar, fulfilling which the player is awarded with Bless Multipliers.
rules.text23: Bless Energy fills a cell of the Bless Bar from the side of the corresponding bonus (Ra - left, Nephthys - right).
rules.text24: If a player collects 3 Bless Energy of the same bonus type IN A ROW, then the player receives the corresponding Bless Multiplier (displayed next to the bonus icon).
rules.text25: The awarded Bless Multiplier is displayed in the "current" field and increases subsequent wins in Free Spins mode.
rules.text26: After fulfilling the Bless Bar, it resets, and the multipliers are replaced with new ones, which are higher.
rules.text27: All possible Bless Multipliers in increasing order:
rules.text28: The mode of the king chosen by the player always provides a higher Bless Multiplier.
rules.text29: Bless Energy of the same bonus type needs to be collected IN A ROW, as the energy of the other bonus type resets the progress of the partially filled Bless Bar (meaning the Bless Bar starts filling from the other side).
rules.text29-1: Complete the Treasury Task by collecting {{value}} symbols of the chosen king (Menelik II or Haile Selassie) in winning combinations, and obtain the Treasury Key.
rules.text29-2: The Treasury Key activates the Key Spot in the middle of the central reel. If the Treasury Symbol lands in Key Spot, the player is awarded with Treasury Bonus.
rules.text30: The Treasury Bonus can only be obtained once per Free Spins mode.
rules.text31: The Treasury Symbol appears only on the third reel in Free Spins mode:
rules.text32: Treasury Symbol is not a paying symbol.
rules.text33: If the player does not select a king for more than 45 seconds during the Choose a King phase, Ra Free Spins will be selected automatically.
